reviewer: Codex author source review; independent approval pending

owner_creation.analysis: OWN-03 allocates one ungot node per queued character; the global head owns the chain, and backward insertion initializes a new node before linking it at the tail.
owner_creation.invariant: Every published queue node has one chain owner.
limitations: No ownership is acquired over the source command string.

aliases_escapes.analysis: OWN-03 tail insertion traverses pu through live nodes while queue consumption reads the same head and successor links. SIGUSR1 can enter the producer independently of that traversal.
aliases_escapes.invariant: A traversal alias must remain valid until link publication.
limitations: There is no generation or borrow guard on pu.

callback_targets.analysis: OWN-03 has an actual asynchronous producer: sigusr1 calls sigusr, which performs lgetenv and ungetsc; ungetsc loops into ungetcc_back and allocates queue nodes.
callback_targets.invariant: Handler work must not enter the allocating queue producer.
limitations: This is the source route recorded by M0-SIG-002, not a new probe.

invalidation.analysis: OWN-03 consuming a node saves its byte/end marker, advances ungot and frees the old node. A concurrent producer or reader cannot retain that removed node address.
invalidation.invariant: Node aliases expire immediately when get_ungot frees it.
limitations: The returned character is a copy, not a retained node borrow.

mutation_commit.analysis: OWN-03 head insertion publishes one initialized node, while tail insertion finds a mutable link through the current chain. Neither update is protected against handler reentry.
mutation_commit.invariant: Queue publication must be serialized with consumption.
limitations: Allocation-before-link is not a whole-queue exclusion protocol.

release_pair.analysis: OWN-03 releases one ecalloc node with free in get_ungot after detaching its successor; ungetsc copies input bytes rather than taking the caller string allocation.
release_pair.invariant: Producer and consumer agree on node allocation/free pairing.
limitations: This release path does not prove pending nodes are drained at exit.

error_cleanup.analysis: OWN-03 has no local allocation-error Result or rollback of a partially queued string: ungetsc can publish earlier characters before a later node allocation fails.
error_cleanup.invariant: Failure must distinguish already queued characters from remaining input.
limitations: No all-or-nothing command-string enqueue guarantee is inferred.

signals_handoff.analysis: OWN-03 retains the open M0-SIG-002 route because sigusr performs lookup, queue mutation and intio inside the handler. Setting notification state afterward does not defer earlier allocation.
signals_handoff.invariant: Asynchronous entry must hand off intent before queue mutation.
limitations: No signal-source change or finding closure is part of this review.
